meta.title: Tailor: a CV and a cover letter for each vacancy
meta.description: Paste a vacancy and get a two-page CV and a cover letter written for it. Every application stays on one board until the answer.

home.heading: A CV and a cover letter for each vacancy
home.lead: Paste a link and the text of a vacancy. Tailor picks what matters for it and builds a two-page CV and a cover letter. Every application stays on one board until the answer.

features.input: A link and the vacancy text are enough to start.
features.cv: A two-page CV with the experience that fits this vacancy.
features.letter: A cover letter and short messages in the same voice.
features.board: One board for every application, from sent to the answer.
